purpose: Test whether a new same-core direct re-observation supplies deployment-visible state that lets a non-parametric reward memory safely target values-stripped registry evidence on the exposed A2T-G1-104 discovery cohort.

predecessor.verdict: static structural and registry-semantic state is live but reward-inseparable; categorical and threshold search on the 217-row logged surface is closed
predecessor.required_change: obtain a genuinely new prospective runtime observation

population.strata: 13 samples per tier across all eight tiers
population.exposure: fully exposed discovery cohort; every result is secondary and cannot carry a generality, confirmatory, superiority, or baseline-lock claim

frozen_contact_zero.semantics: the original one-contact answer and the STOP_M0 final answer; it is reused without model contact
frozen_contact_zero.known_before_registration: a prior G1 direct re-flight was byte-identical on 93 of 104 samples; its per-sample relation to the new signed-return surface is not reused

agent_loop.frozen_core: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct Q4_K_M through the receipt-pinned llama.cpp API-shaped boundary
agent_loop.speech_carriage: the exact original speech-feature packet is carried on every new contact
agent_loop.phase_1: REOBSERVE_DIRECT: replay the byte-identical M0 messages once and seal all 104 responses before phase 2
agent_loop.phase_2: SUPPLY_UNION_STRIPPED: deterministically render the union of registry rows selected in frozen M0 and REOBSERVE_DIRECT, strip argument_defaults, and make one evidence contact per sample
agent_loop.stop_semantics: return the frozen M0 answer; the observation contact never silently replaces the final answer
agent_loop.unresolved_supply: when neither response yields a registry-resolved tool, SUPPLY_UNION_STRIPPED is unavailable and the action is STOP_M0

renderer.source: reuse the registered Stage-2B values-stripped registry-row renderer
renderer.tool_selection: parse both response call lists with the frozen scorer parser; take the unique union of registry-resolved predicted tool names
renderer.ordering: ascending numeric registry tool_id; response order, duplicate calls, and source row order cannot change the payload
renderer.retained_fields: all other fields of each selected registry row
renderer.forbidden: gold tool names, expected arguments, reference text, sample tier, sample identity, reward, or any future response

coarse: predicted tool-multiset relation: exact, overlap, disjoint, unresolved
detailed_additions: per-tool argument-key-signature relation: exact, mixed, different, unresolved
per-tool argument-value relation: exact, mixed, different, unresolved
forbidden: reference transcript or spoken query text
sample id, query_idx, rendition id, or tier as a feature
tool name, registry domain, category, description, or argument values as a feature
phase-2 response, reward, or future turn

training_free_reward_memory.type: five-fold whole-query-group cross-fitted hierarchical exact-cell action-return memory
training_free_reward_memory.decision: use the most-specific other-fold matching cell, detailed before coarse; select supply only with support at least 4, at least 2 saves, and zero harms; otherwise stop
training_free_reward_memory.candidate_selection: among candidates passing every gate, maximize cross-fitted exact-match net gain, then saved exact matches, then minimize supply contacts, then lexical candidate id

evaluation.seal_before_score: both complete 104-row new-contact arms seal before gold is opened
evaluation.official_scorer: one complete official scorer invocation per arm

outer_parallelism.aggregation: no dataset sharding and no averaging of shard-level metrics

mandatory_reports: exact match, tool accuracy, slot micro-F1, empty-call rate, parse-failure rate
saves, harms, net gain, action rate, and contacts per sample
all eight tiers without tier-conditioned tuning
byte, parsed-tool, key-signature, and value agreement between M0 and re-observation
parallel scorer wall time, per-job time, result hashes, and scorer identity

decision_ladder.failure: write a negative artifact, close same-core direct self-consistency as the next Audio2Tool targeting signal, and make no new contact
decision_ladder.success: freeze one training-free controller and preregister an actual-policy support run on the remaining exposed discovery cohort; do not open G2 or revise the baseline
decision_ladder.support_success: only a separately registered stable prospective gain may propose G2 or Stage-3 promotion

precontact_requirements: structured contracts.ExecutionPlan committed with this row as exposure_pre_registration_id
split identity, protocol hash, source hashes, packet receipt, runtime receipt, and attempt budget validated fail-closed
model-free prompt-fit and renderer-identity gates pass
official scorer manifests and two-job outer-parallel score table are prepared but not executed
